{"id":1849272065,"question_id":3879,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765111513,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1849272065/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find Minimum Log Transportation Cost","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long minCuttingCost(int n, int m, int k) {\n        if(n < k and m < k) return 0;\n        int needed = n > k ? n : m;\n        int cost = 0;\n        while(needed > k)\n        {\n            int part_cut = needed - k;\n            needed = needed - part_cut;\n            cost += part_cut * needed;\n        }\n        return cost;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-minimum-log-transportation-cost","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1253}
